fields.description: WebSocket URL for browsers on this machine (e.g. ws://localhost:7880). When users open the site via a LAN IP (192.168.x.x), the API rewrites this to ws://<that-ip>:7880 automatically. Set LiveKit URL (server / API) to ws://livekit:7880 in Docker.
fields.label: LiveKit URL (clients)

fields.description: Optional. URL the Frappe server uses to call LiveKit HTTP API (agent dispatch). In Docker Compose use ws://livekit:7880 when clients use localhost above. Leave empty only if this server can reach the client URL.
fields.label: LiveKit URL (server / API)

fields.description: Gemini **Live API** voice model id (Google AI). Recommended: gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025 (matches livekit-plugins-google). Optional: gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview if your API key accepts it. Do not use **Flash-Lite** here (text only; use Judge Model). Wrong ids fall back to the default.
fields.label: Gemini Live Model

fields.description: Gemini model id for **post-call** scoring (text `generate_content`, not Live voice). Must match a model your API key can use (e.g. gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, gemini-2.5-flash).
fields.label: Judge Model

fields.description: Must match the LiveKit agent worker registration name.
fields.label: LiveKit Agent Name

fields.description: Base URL of the ERPNext / Frappe site the MCP server calls (e.g. http://localhost:8000 or https://mysite.frappe.cloud).
fields.label: ERPNext URL (MCP)

fields.description: API Key from ERPNext User > My Settings > API Access.
fields.label: ERPNext API Key

fields.description: API Secret from ERPNext User > My Settings > API Access.
fields.label: ERPNext API Secret

fields.description: LiveKit worker name for the ERPNext analytics voice agent (must match worker registration).
fields.label: Analytics LiveKit agent name

fields.description: USD to NPR conversion rate used to show operating cost in local currency.
fields.label: USD to NPR Rate
